## Operating Invariants
- Modular HTML Motion Architecture: Author films directly inside the opened project folder (`index.html`, `script/scene1..N.js`, `audio/*.wav`, `img/*`, `ref/*`, `output/*.mp4`) with deterministic `window.renderAt(t)` and `window.__ready = true`.
- Zero Node/Remotion Dependencies: Never create React/Remotion folders (`src/`, `public/`, `Root.tsx`); use pure browser Canvas 2D / SVG / CSS + Vanilla JS (`window.AM`) with headless Chrome/Edge CDP MP4 export.
- Active Folder Isolation: Only inspect and operate on files within the currently opened active workspace folder.
